title: The motel application, i
logline: Monday. The ad in the coastal weekly: NIGHT AUDITOR · DRIFTWOOD MOTEL. It runs on the page beside the strip. The strip draws the page.

panels.composition: Gully's. WOOD reading the coastal weekly on the stool. BARNABY. The page: the tide tables, the strip (a week old), and a classified.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man reading a folded coastal weekly newspaper on a bait-shop stool, an old dog beneath

panels.composition: The page, close: the strip in its box, and beside it, the classified: NIGHT AUDITOR · DRIFTWOOD MOTEL · 11P–7A · APPLY IN PERSON.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a newspaper page showing a small comic strip beside a classified advertisement box
image.notes: Letter after: NIGHT AUDITOR · DRIFTWOOD MOTEL · 11P–7A · APPLY IN PERSON.

panels.composition: Wood looking from the strip to the ad. Gully reading over his shoulder.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a stocky man in an apron reading over a thin man's shoulder at a newspaper

panels.composition: Wood tearing the ad out. Carefully. Around the strip, not through it.
